  - main:
    - text: CLASS 12 · FORMAL CALCULUS
    - heading "Tangents and Normals" [level=1]
    - paragraph: For f(x)=x², at x=1, point P(1, 1). Derivative slope f'(1)=2.
    - text: 30 min RIGOROUS PROOF interactive
    - complementary:
      - heading "FUNCTIONS & LINES" [level=3]
      - checkbox "f(x)=x²" [checked]
      - text: f(x)=x²
      - 'checkbox "Tangent: y = 2x -1" [checked]'
      - text: "Tangent: y = 2x -1"
      - 'checkbox "Normal: y - 1 = -0.5(x - 1)" [checked]'
      - text: "Normal: y - 1 = -0.5(x - 1)"
      - checkbox "Point P(1, 1)" [checked]
      - text: Point P(1, 1)
      - checkbox "Secant PQ"
      - text: Secant PQ
      - heading "TOOLS" [level=3]
      - text: x₀
      - slider "Tangent point x zero": "1"
      - text: Q x
      - slider "Secant point x": "1.5"
      - status: "1.5"
      - heading "ZOOM" [level=3]
      - button "Zoom in":
        - img
      - button "Zoom out":
        - img
      - button "Reset":
        - img
        - text: Reset
    - article:
      - img "Tangent and normal graph":
        - slider "Graph secant point Q"
        - text: P(1, 1) Q(1.5, 2.25) y=x²
    - complementary:
      - heading "TANGENT SLOPE (DERIVATIVE)" [level=3]
      - strong: f'(1) = lim h→0 [f(1+h)-f(1)]/h = 2
      - paragraph: Slope of tangent = 2
      - heading "NORMAL SLOPE" [level=3]
      - strong: mₙ = -1/mₜ = -0.5
      - heading "AT x=1" [level=3]
      - list:
        - listitem: Point P(1, 1)
        - listitem: f'(1)=2
        - listitem: Tangent slope=2
        - listitem: Normal slope=-0.5
    - article:
      - heading "DERIVATION OF EQUATIONS" [level=3]
      - heading "Tangent (Point-Slope Form)" [level=4]
      - paragraph: y-y₁=mₜ(x-x₁)
      - paragraph: y = 2x -1
      - text: Tangent Equation
      - heading "Normal (Point-Slope Form)" [level=4]
      - paragraph: mₙ=-1/mₜ=-0.5
      - paragraph: y - 1 = -0.5(x - 1)
      - text: Normal Equation
    - article:
      - heading "SECANT APPROACHING TANGENT" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The slope of secant PQ is mPQ=(f(x₀)-f(1))/(x₀-1).
      - table:
        - rowgroup:
          - row "x₀ Q(x₀,f(x₀)) mPQ":
            - columnheader "x₀"
            - columnheader "Q(x₀,f(x₀))"
            - columnheader "mPQ"
        - rowgroup:
          - row "1.5 (1.5, 2.25) 2.5":
            - cell "1.5"
            - cell "(1.5, 2.25)"
            - cell "2.5"
          - row "1.2 (1.2, 1.44) 2.2":
            - cell "1.2"
            - cell "(1.2, 1.44)"
            - cell "2.2"
          - row "1.1 (1.1, 1.21) 2.1":
            - cell "1.1"
            - cell "(1.1, 1.21)"
            - cell "2.1"
          - row "1.01 (1.01, 1.0201) 2.01":
            - cell "1.01"
            - cell "(1.01, 1.0201)"
            - cell "2.01"
          - row "1.001 (1.001, 1.002) 2.001":
            - cell "1.001"
            - cell "(1.001, 1.002)"
            - cell "2.001"
          - row "1.0001 (1.0001, 1.0002) 2.0001":
            - cell "1.0001"
            - cell "(1.0001, 1.0002)"
            - cell "2.0001"
      - text: As x₀→1, mPQ→2, the tangent slope.
    - article:
      - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=3]
      - paragraph: At x=1, f(1)=1 and f'(1)=2.
      - paragraph: "Tangent: y-1=2(x-1), so y=2x-1."
      - paragraph: Normal slope=-1/2, so y-1=-1/2(x-1).
      - text: "Answer: tangent y=2x-1; normal y-1=-1/2(x-1)."
    - article:
      - heading "COMMON MISCONCEPTION" [level=3]
      - text: The normal at a point is not the y-axis or x=x₀.
      - paragraph: It must be perpendicular to the tangent, so its slope is the negative reciprocal whenever the tangent slope is nonzero.
    - article:
      - heading "PRACTICE TABLE (FOR f(x)=x²)" [level=3]
      - table:
        - rowgroup:
          - row "x₀ P f'(x₀) Tangent Normal":
            - columnheader "x₀"
            - columnheader "P"
            - columnheader "f'(x₀)"
            - columnheader "Tangent"
            - columnheader "Normal"
        - rowgroup:
          - row "0 (0,0) 0 y=0 x=0":
            - cell "0"
            - cell "(0,0)"
            - cell "0"
            - cell "y=0"
            - cell "x=0"
          - row "1 (1,1) 2 y-1=2(x-1) y-1=-0.5(x-1)":
            - cell "1"
            - cell "(1,1)"
            - cell "2"
            - cell "y-1=2(x-1)"
            - cell "y-1=-0.5(x-1)"
          - row "2 (2,4) 4 y-4=4(x-2) y-4=-0.25(x-2)":
            - cell "2"
            - cell "(2,4)"
            - cell "4"
            - cell "y-4=4(x-2)"
            - cell "y-4=-0.25(x-2)"
          - row "-1 (-1,1) -2 y-1=-2(x--1) y-1=0.5(x--1)":
            - cell "-1"
            - cell "(-1,1)"
            - cell "-2"
            - cell "y-1=-2(x--1)"
            - cell "y-1=0.5(x--1)"
    - article:
      - heading "TRY IT YOURSELF" [level=3]

      - text: Q x
      - slider "Practice secant x": "1.5"
